headline: Embry-Riddle stretch unbeaten start with fifth win
dek: Embry-Riddle beat SCAD at home for a fifth win, the draw at Spring Hill the only point they have dropped. They have conceded six goals in all, and no side has beaten them at home or away.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: The goals are pooled at the top of the chart, not spread through it: Florida Southern alone have outscored Barry, Eckerd and Nova Southeastern put together, and none of those sides has yet taken a point in conference play.

wire.line: Florida Southern's first defeat leaves Embry-Riddle and Lynn as the only unbeaten sides.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Three matches have passed their date with no result, and all three are Palm Beach Atlantic's: against Florida Atlantic, Barry and Strive Academy.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Lynn have won both of their matches at home and drawn all three away, and are yet to lose.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Florida Southern have won five matches and lost one, at Saint Leo, and have conceded five goals all season.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Rollins have lost both of their matches, at home to Embry-Riddle and then at Tampa, and have scored once while conceding four.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Ricardo Marques has kept four clean sheets for Florida Southern and has conceded five goals in all.

last_match.line: Saint Leo have still not lost at home; Tampa have gone four matches without defeat.

next_match.line: Lynn have yet to lose this season; Florida Southern have yet to concede at home.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
